sections.title: Perfect or preterite?: meaning and form
body: Goal: Choose between a completed past event and a past experience that is relevant now.
Core vocabulary: en erfarenhet, nyss, redan. Key phrases: Jag bokade tiden i går. · Jag har bokat en tid. · Har du någonsin rest ensam?

Use preterite with a finished past time: Jag ringde i går. Use har + supine for experience or a result connected to now when no finished time is stated: Jag har ringt kundtjänsten. A finished time expression such as i går normally selects preterite.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Jag har skickat in formuläret.” is a neutral service update way to express “I have submitted the form.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What has the speaker already done? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: When did the customer send the application? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Tell a service worker what happened at a specific time and explain what you have already done about it. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a short update about a practical problem. Include one dated past event, one completed action relevant now and one action not done yet. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: Instead of losing a travel card, you missed a medical appointment; report the event and your current actions.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
assignment.model: Jag bokade tiden i går. Jag har bokat en tid. Har du någonsin rest ensam?

takeaways: Use: Jag bokade tiden i går.
Notice: Use preterite with a finished past time: Jag ringde i går.
